results.name: Iron Filings
results.description: Thousands of iron filings that line up along a real bar-magnet field. The cursor carries the magnet; click to drop more and watch their field lines merge. Canvas 2D, pauses off-screen, respects reduced motion, keyboard: Enter drops a magnet, Escape clears.

results.name: Threshold: The Mirror - Immersive Scroll Portal
results.description: A scroll-controlled journey from a real street into another world, built with React 19, TypeScript, Vite and three.js. In "The mirror", a gilded looking glass on a Venice quay wakes up at sunrise and shows a garden in Nagoya; scroll and you step through the glass. The mirror is a real 3D object standing inside a 360-degree photograph, with true portal rendering (the other world is rendered live through the glass), image-based lighting, a dimension-shift post effect at the crossing, look-around with inertia once you arrive, and procedural sound that stays off until you turn it on. Wheel, touch and keyboard all scrub the journey, and reduced motion swaps the travel for a crossfade. Panoramas are real places from Poly Haven (CC0). Part of Threshold, a set of 76 portal experiences by Neebarp.
results.author: neebarp

results.name: Okuda & Vale - Architecture Studio Template
results.description: A Next.js 16, React 19 and Tailwind v4 website for architecture, engineering and design studios. Includes a home page with 10 sections, a filterable work index, 6 project pages, a studio page and a 404. The signature feature is a rotatable three.js massing model with a real sun study: pick a date, scrub the hour and watch true shadows move. Floor plans draw themselves as you scroll, with a light "drawing sheet" mode and a dark "blueprint" mode. Every visual is built in code (SVG, CSS, WebGL), with no stock or AI imagery and nothing to license, and all colours live in one theme.css. Fully static; the contact form calls a single function you connect to your own endpoint.
results.author: neebarp
